review_evidence: README identifies ZFLean as a practical framework for set-theoretical development in Lean.

A complete proposition-declaration scan found 662 theorem/lemma/example declarations across 10 of the 12 files, including naturals, integers, rationals, functions, embeddings, isomorphisms, booleans, and foundational set definitions.
ZFLean.lean is the library import surface; no build/runtime-only primary material remains in this unit.
summary: Reviewed ZFLean and retain all 12 current-primary files as a theorem-rich set-theoretic development.

review_evidence: Declaration-keyword grep counts: Naturals.lean 243, Integers.lean 216, Functions.lean 175, Rationals.lean 157, Booleans.lean 87, casestudy/ImpObligations.lean 90, casestudy/Imp.lean 76, Sum.lean 60, Def.lean 33, Isomorphisms.lean 30, Basic.lean 25, Quotient.lean 22, Recursion.lean 17, Examples.lean 15, Transfer.lean 11, Embeddings.lean 6, TransferAlgebra.lean 1.
ZFLean.lean (273 bytes, read in full): `module` plus public imports of the ZFLean submodules; an import aggregator retained under FILTER-007 because auxiliary navigation delivery is not verified.

scripts/audit_axioms.lean (read in full): #print axioms over the paper's headline theorems (ZFSet.isIso_of_biembedding, ZFSet.Card.spec, ZFSet.Imp.Cmd.sem_whileDo_least, and others) and a run_cmd exhaustive axiom audit; it names the main results and is retained.

ZFLean/Tactics.lean (head read): registers label attributes zrel, zpfun, zfun, zdom and defines the corresponding tactics (4 syntax/macro commands); the 9 'sorry' grep hits are the sorry_if_sorry tactic name, not proof holes.
ZFLean/TransferAlgebra.lean (head read): puts Mathlib map_add/map_mul lemmas into the transfer_simps set for bundled isomorphisms; a tactic interface for the transfer mechanism.
ZFLean/Examples.lean (head read): documented `example` proofs that transfer ZFNat/ZFInt/ZFRat goals to ℕ/ℤ/ℚ (strong induction, least number principle, archimedean property).
casestudy/ImpObligations.lean (head read): states the 30 side obligations of the Imp case study under three search configurations and checks the counts claimed in the paper.
summary: Surveyed all 20 files (ZFLean/, casestudy/, scripts/, root) with byte sizes, a per-file grep count of Lean declaration keywords, and a sorry count. Read the smallest and outlier files in full or at the head: ZFLean.lean, scripts/audit_axioms.lean, ZFLean/Tactics.lean (head), ZFLean/TransferAlgebra.lean (head), ZFLean/Examples.lean (head), casestudy/ImpObligations.lean (head). The unit is a ZF set theory development in Lean (functions, naturals, integers, rationals, sums, quotients, isomorphisms, transfer tactic) plus an Imp semantics case study. Every file holds formal definitions, theorems, examples, tactic interfaces, or module navigation. No exclusions; all 20 files are retained.
